name: Noisy network — high alert volume
description: Four different ONTs across both branches are experiencing four different fault types at the same time. This creates a high volume of alerts that the agent must triage and group. Key challenge: ONT-01-01 (power off) and ONT-01-03 (hung) are on the same PON branch but have unrelated causes. ONT-02-01 (flapping) and ONT-02-04 (degraded) are also independent. No shared root cause — the agent must handle each separately.
